conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.message: What are some of the other nuances of AI capabilities that you find particularly interesting?

conversation.message: One interesting nuance is the distinction between narrow AI, designed for specific tasks, and the theoretical concept of general AI, capable of performing any intellectual task a human can.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
